RUHS Medical Officer Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS) has released the notification for the Medical Officer Posts. This recruitment has been issued for 600 posts. The online application process for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 has started from 14 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 13 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 September 2026
  • Last Date : 13 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 13 December 2026
  • Admit Card : 08 December 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 5000/-
  • SC, ST (For Rajasthan State) : Rs. 2500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
